messages.author: Leena Kuusisto
messages.text: Vesa, OLT-210 at the Hakkila hub is throwing high temperature alarms, inlet 61 degrees. The cabinet is outdoors, 2015 build. Can you take a look?

messages.author: Raisa Turunen
messages.text: Check the dust filter on the door first. That cabinet type clogs with pollen in spring and then the fans can't pull enough air.

messages.author: Vesa Hakala
messages.text: At the cabinet. The filter is nearly solid with pollen. Fans are spinning normally.

messages.author: Raisa Turunen
messages.text: Swap it for a clean one, spare filters are in the van.

messages.author: Vesa Hakala
messages.text: Swapped for a clean filter. Temperature is dropping, 54 now.

messages.author: Leena Kuusisto
messages.text: I see 47 degrees on the NOC side. Alarm cleared.

messages.author: Raisa Turunen
messages.text: Also, someone remind me to book the training room for Thursday.

messages.author: Vesa Hakala
messages.text: Closing the visit. Filter swapped, alarm cleared.
